target.title: fix: iOS Talk fallback settings opens Voice & Talk
target.body:
Closes #98593

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users who hit the iOS Talk fallback banner would tap "Open Settings" and land on Settings / Gateway instead of the Voice & Talk settings page.

## Why This Change Was Made

Talk-specific settings actions now have a separate Voice settings route, while gateway/offline repair actions continue to open Gateway settings. This keeps the fallback banner, details sheet, Voice mode card, and Voice & Talk controls pointed at the relevant settings page without changing Talk runtime behavior.

## User Impact

Users who see the iOS Speech fallback banner can go directly to Voice & Talk settings instead of hunting through the Settings root or Gateway page.

## Evidence

- Created/linked issue: #98593
- `swiftlint lint apps/ios/Sources/Design/TalkProTab.swift --quiet --strict --config apps/ios/.swiftlint.yml`
- `swiftlint lint apps/ios/Sources/RootTabs.swift --quiet --strict --config apps/ios/.swiftlint.yml`
- `git diff --check`
- `xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClaw -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17,OS=26.5' -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsSourceGuardTests -only-testing:OpenClawTests/RootTabsPresentationTests` passed 77 Swift Testing tests.
- `codex review --base origin/main` found no concrete regression after generated Xcode package-resolution churn was restored.
- Real iOS simulator behavior proof from PR head `1c44447a4f942f11e5b1477c07f6336a5373ed91`:
  - Proof branch: https://github.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/tree/proof/pr-98602-settings-route/proof/pr-98602
  - Talk button proof image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/proof/pr-98602-settings-route/proof/pr-98602/talk-button-opens-voice-settings-20260701T1612.png
    - SHA-256: `010b3686c49b43905f2e55217727804bc8a12013a03a86705bf40f0def3fd224`
    - Visual readback: after tapping the actual Talk screen `Voice & Talk settings` button, the app shows the `Voice & Talk` route title, `Voice & Talk` settings card, and the Settings tab selected.
  - Gateway route proof image: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PollyBot13/openclaw/proof/pr-98602-settings-route/proof/pr-98602/gateway-route-preserved-20260701T1612.png
    - SHA-256: `14b39ba1e5f32f800e8524771d21836d55f04e3295e95e120365d10de53267e9`
    - Visual readback: the preserved Gateway settings route shows the `Gateway` route title, Gateway detail card, and the Settings tab selected.
  - Proof command: `xcodebuild test -project apps/ios/OpenClaw.xcodeproj -scheme OpenClawUITests -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17,OS=26.5' -only-testing:OpenClawUITests/OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testTalkSettingsRouteProofScreenshots -resultBundlePath /tmp/pr98602-proof.xcresult -derivedDataPath /tmp/pr98602-proof-dd CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO ARCHS=arm64 ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=YES VALID_ARCHS=arm64` passed 1 UI proof test with 0 failures. The temporary proof harness tapped the Talk button, waited for `Voice & Talk`, then launched the Gateway route and waited for `Gateway`; it is not part of this PR diff.

AI-assisted: yes.
